description.value: The Peachland Branch of the Okanagan Regional Library is a publicly accessible branch of the 30-location ORL network, one of the 16th largest library systems in Canada, situated in the small lakeside community of Peachland on the western shore of Okanagan Lake. The branch is fully wheelchair accessible via ramp and offers public internet computers and wireless printing to anyone who visits. Free public parking is available at the adjacent Peachland Village Mall, making it a convenient stop along the Okanagan cycling corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The official website confirms the branch is active, lists 'Wireless printing' and OSM tags internet_access=wlan together confirming Wi-Fi; no explicit mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill appears anywhere in the website content. A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records house number 40 while the website clearly states 5500 Clements Crescent — the website value is used and the discrepancy is flagged. The OSM community field lists Naramata, but this branch is explicitly located in Peachland, suggesting a dataset categorization error.
